label: Uneasy
summary: The Gulf war still sets the tone. Cargo ships were reported sunk in the Strait of Hormuz and the Houthis claimed an attack on Riyadh. Russian missiles hit homes and a power plant in Kyiv, and North Korea tested two submarine-launched missiles. US inflation rose to 3.7% in September and stocks slipped on fears of a rate rise, though China's exports surged on AI demand. Kenya confirmed a second Ebola case while DR Congo's outbreak passed 9,000 cases. Floods killed a teenager in Istanbul, and hail and flooding hit Santiago. There was quieter good news: a study found Africa is gaining disaster resilience faster than anywhere else, scientists offered an explanation for the Moon's two faces, and a Samoan-language song made history in New Zealand. The weighted formula gave 40; no editorial adjustment.
